source.name: Sentiment Labelled Sentences (UCI)
source.citation: Kotzias, Denil, de Freitas & Smyth, "From Group to Individual Labels using Deep Features", KDD 2015
source.sampling: 120 sentences of 12–160 characters, half positive, seeded (11) from the IMDB, Amazon and Yelp files

task.name: sentiment
task.instructions: Decide whether this short review is positive or negative.

criteria.positive: The reviewer is satisfied, praises or recommends.
criteria.negative: The reviewer is dissatisfied, complains or warns against.
